# Responsive Mockup Studio

> Responsive Mockup Studio is a bilingual YCSWU Tools application for placing live responsive websites inside customizable technical device mockups and exporting production-ready images.

Canonical URL: https://ycswu.co/mockup-studio/
Publisher: YCSWU
Creator: Ali Guzel
Version: 1.2.6
Languages: Turkish and English
Platforms: Web and Windows desktop

## Core capabilities

- Preview a URL at desktop, tablet, phone or custom responsive viewport sizes.
- Use custom frames or fixed-ratio desktop, ultrawide, laptop, tablet and phone frames.
- Change supported frame colors, materials, roughness, reflectivity and surface glare.
- Enable an adjustable wireframe treatment without hiding the website screen.
- Remove or restore supported physical parts such as a desktop stem, base, device detail, laptop lip or phone side controls.
- Adjust camera zoom, X/Y position and three-axis tilt; pan with the middle mouse button and zoom with the wheel.
- Frame the composition at 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9 in portrait or landscape orientation.
- Save custom devices locally, favorite ready frames and bookmark or revisit URLs.
- Export PNG, transparent PNG, JPG, WebP and SVG.
- Convert website text to font-independent vector outlines in SVG export.
- Hide page scrollbars, cursor or selected CSS elements during preview and export.
- Switch between dark/light themes and Turkish/English interface text.

## Web and Windows behavior

The Windows version uses an embedded Chromium webview and can load and capture unrestricted external websites while retaining browser sessions. The static web version follows normal browser iframe and cross-origin policies, so a remote site may refuse to appear inside an iframe. The editor and local frame workflow remain available on the web.

## Output behavior

Raster and SVG exports reproduce the framed preview composition rather than tiling the source page. SVG device geometry and CSS shapes remain vector. Website text is converted to vector paths; bitmap photographs remain bitmap assets.

## Privacy

Project settings, bookmarks, favorites and saved custom devices are stored locally in the user's application/browser profile. The static web package does not require a server-side database.
